title: Riso
look: Two-ink risograph: halftone fills in pink and blue, slightly misregistered, grainy paper.

doc.essence: A risograph print in two or three inks: halftone screens, overprinted blue a hair off register.
doc.notIt: Not comic (no black line, inks not process colours), not screenprint (halftone, not flat).
doc.shapes: No outline; a blue copy of the silhouette is offset like a misregistered plate.
doc.colour: Every colour snaps to fluorescent pink, blue, yellow or paper.
pitfalls: Two roles snapping to the same ink merge: tweak the palette.
